title: Could not imagine I would return here as Supreme Court judge: Justice Mohana at Madras HC
description: Supreme Court Justice V Mohana on Monday said it was unimaginable to her as a student that she would one day deliver a lecture at the Madras High Court after taking office as a judge of the Supreme Court. Justice Mohana was felicitated by the Madras Bar Association in the presence of the Chief Justice of the Madras High Court SA Dharmadikari, on the occasion of the inauguration of endowment lectures to commemorate legal luminaries MK Nambyar, VP Raman, R Krishnamurthi and M Subramaniam.Justice M
